description: Raw Dryad GPS fixes (original row order, NaN/-1 speed as in source, NaN -> null) with window features computed by Phase 2 (windows_5s.csv, produced by ml/preprocessing/phase2_build_windows.py). Cleaning: confInterval NaN/<0/>50 dropped, exact duplicates dropped, iterative teleport drop >10 m/s, speed<0/NaN invalid, windows overlapping a >10 s gap between kept fixes excluded, windows with no fix or no valid speed excluded, 5 s non-overlapping windows [start+k*5000, +5000) from window_grid_start_ms, lag_* = previous window k-1 (NaN if absent). Features order = feature_order; NaN -> null.
